hints.title: Core Idea
hints.text: Every valid substring is determined by a pair of occurrences of character c (inclusive of single-character substrings).

hints.title: Key Observation
hints.text: If character c appears m times in s, any choice of starting index and ending index (with start <= end) gives a valid substring.

hints.title: Algorithmic Steps
hints.text: Count occurrences m of c. Return m * (m + 1) // 2.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Single pass count and arithmetic combination formula.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Examining all substrings takes quadratic time O(n^2).
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use combinatorial formula m * (m + 1) / 2 based on frequency count.
